title: Art. 9.32 — Annex 9 - Facilitation, Chapter 9 - Passenger Data Exchange Systems, D. Passenger Name Record (PNR), 9.32
content: Recommended Practice. Contracting States should retain PNR data for a maximum period of five years after the transfer of PNR data, except when required in the course of an investigation, prosecution, or court proceeding.
